Job Title: Accountant Officer
Company: null
Location: Sen Sok, Phnom Penh, Cambodia
Employment Type: Full Time
Job Level: Junior Level
Years of Experience: 1 Year +
Qualification: Bachelor
Salary: $500 - $800

Job Responsibilities:
• Data Entry & Bookkeeping: Perform daily posting of bills and sales invoices into QuickBooks, ensuring all accounts and amounts are recorded accurately.
• Account Reconciliation: Assist in weekly and monthly cash and bank reconciliations to ensure internal records match bank statements.
• Documentation: Handle the filing and organized checking of all financial documents provided by clients or internal departments.
• AR/AP Tracking: Monitor and track Accounts Receivable and Accounts Payable to ensure timely payments and collections.
• Reporting Support: Assist in extracting data to produce weekly and monthly financial reports for review by senior management.
• Tax Assistance: Provide administrative support during the preparation of monthly and yearly tax returns.
• Month-End Support: Support the accounting team in meeting deadlines for month-end closing procedures.
• Communication: Coordinate with clients or other departments to gather missing information or clarify basic transaction details.
• Other Tasks: Perform additional administrative or accounting duties as assigned by management.

Job Requirements & Qualifications:
• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field (Fresh graduates are encouraged to apply).
• Experience: 0–1 year of experience in accounting or bookkeeping (Internship experience is a plus).
• Technical Skills: * Basic knowledge of computerized accounting systems (e.g., QuickBooks).
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office, with a focus on MS Excel (formulas, data entry).
• Knowledge: Understanding of basic accounting principles (Debits/Credits) and an interest in learning local taxation.
• Languages: Fair to Good command of the English language.
• Soft Skills: High attention to detail, a strong desire to learn, and a commitment to accuracy.
